（（「本公司」），連同其附屬公司，統稱「本集團」）   outlook for the year ending 31 December 2023 of Longfor Group Holdings
截至二零二三年十二月三十一日止之全年業務回       Limited (the “Company”, together with its subsidiaries, collectively the
顧與展望。                       “Group”).

我國經濟發展重心從「高增長」轉向「高質量」，房     The focus of China’s economic development has shifted from prioritizing “high
地產市場經歷過去兩年的調整，供求關係在穩市       growth” to “high quality”. Over the past two years, the real estate market
場、防風險、促轉型的主基調下尋求新的平衡。       has experienced cyclical adjustments, and has been in the process of striking
新形勢下，龍湖集團圍繞高質量發展的核心戰        a new equilibrium between supply and demand under the themes of market
略，主動調整、扎實執行。                stabilization, risk management, and transformation facilitation. In response to
                            this new landscape, Longfor Group has proactively adjusted its operations and
                            firmly executed its core strategy centered around high-quality development.

財務安全是本公司發展的基石。截至二零二三        Financial security is the bedrock of the Company’s development. The Group’s
年底本集團有息負債餘額人民幣1,926億較二零     interest-bearing liabilities as of the end of 2023 totaled RMB192.6 billion,
二二年下降7.4%，其中銀行融資佔比達77%。我    representing a decrease of 7.4% as compared to 2022, with bank financing
們長久以來堅決遵循按時還貸、不展期、不逾期       accounting for 77%. We have steadfastly long adhered to the financial discipline
的財務鐵律，換來戰略合作銀行的持續信任與支       of repaying loans on time, avoiding rollovers and late payments, which earned
持，成為我們穿越週期的強大底氣。在如今政策       us continued trust and support from our strategic partner banks, strengthening
的支持下，本集團進一步加大經營性物業貸款融       our solid foundation to navigate economic cycles. Backed by current policies, the
資力度，以更優的成本，進一步拉長平均合同借       Group has intensified efforts to raise funds through operating property loans,
貸年期。未來，我們將持續通過穩步有序地壓降       thereby further extending the average contract borrowing period at a more
負債，優化債務結構，確保底線安全。           favorable cost. Moving forward, we will continue to optimize our debt structure
                            by gradually and orderly reducing our indebtedness to ensure sustainability of our

     具備作出穩健商業判斷的能力；              to exercise sound business judgment;

3.   與現有董事會相輔相成的技能；        3.    skills that are complementary to those of the existing Board;

4.   協助及支持管理層的能力，以及為本公司    4.    the ability to assist and support management and make significant
     的成功作出重大貢獻；                  contributions to the Company’s success;

     該等責任所需的時間及精力；及              member of the Board and the commitment of time and energy necessary to

     意見                                                   OPINION
     本核數師（以下簡稱「我們」）已審計列載於第104                             We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Longfor Group
     頁至第307頁的龍湖集團控股有限公司（「貴公                               Holdings Limited (the “Company”) and its subsidiaries (collectively referred to
     司」）及其附屬公司（統稱「貴集團」）的綜合財務                              as the “Group”) set out on pages 104 to 307, which comprise the consolidated
     報表，此綜合財務報表包括於二零二三年十二月                                statement of financial position as at December 31, 2023, and the consolidated
     三十一日的綜合財務狀況報表及於截至該日止年                                statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, consolidated
     度的綜合損益及其他全面收益表、綜合權益變動                                statement of changes in equity and consolidated statement of cash flows for the
     表及綜合現金流量表，以及綜合財務報表附註，                                year then ended, and notes to the consolidated financial statements, including
     包括重大會計政策資料及其他解釋資料。                                   material accounting policy information and other explanatory information.

     我們認為，該等綜合財務報表已根據國際會計準                                In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements give a true and fair view of
     則理事會（「國際會計準則理事會」）頒佈的《國際                              the consolidated financial position of the Group as at December 31, 2023, and
     財務報告準則》
           （「國際財務報告準則」）真實而中                               of its consolidated financial performance and its consolidated cash flows for the
     肯地反映 貴集團於二零二三年十二月三十一日                                year then ended in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards
     的綜合財務狀況及截至該日止年度 貴集團的綜                                (“IFRSs”) issued by the International Accounting Standards Board (“IASB”) and
     合財務表現及其綜合現金流量，並已遵照香港                                 have been properly prepared in compliance with the disclosure requirements of

      12. 投資物業                                             12. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES
            本集團根據經營租賃出租各公寓及零售店                                  The Group leases out various apartments and retail stores under operating
            舖，須按月支付租金。租賃的初始期限一                                  leases with rentals payable monthly. The leases typically run for an initial
            般為1個月至20年。零售店舖的租賃包含                                 period of 1 month to 20 years. The leases of retail stores contain variable
            按1%至30%銷售計算的浮動租賃付款及根                                lease payment that are based on 1% to 30% of sales or minimum annual
            據租期固定的最低年度租賃付款。                                     lease payment that are fixed over the lease term.

            本集團因租賃安排未面臨外幣風險，原因                                  The Group is not exposed to foreign currency risk as a result of the lease
            為所有租賃均以集團實體各自的功能貨                                   arrangements, as all leases are denominated in the respective functional
            幣計值。租賃合約並無載列剩餘價值擔保                                  currencies of group entities. The lease contracts do not contain residual
            及╱或承租人於租期結束時購買物業的選                                  value guarantee and/or lessee’s option to purchase the property at the end
            擇權。                                                 of lease term.

  本集團管理資本以確保本集團的實體能持                 The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will
  續經營，同時透過優化債務及股本結餘為                 be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to
  股東帶來最大回報。                          shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.

  本集團的資本結構包括債務淨額（包括                  The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which includes,
  分別於附註30及31披露的借款及優先票                where appropriate, the borrowings and senior notes disclosed in notes
  據）、現金及現金等價物淨額以及本公司                 30 and 31 respectively, net of cash and cash equivalents and equity
  擁有人應佔權益（包括已發行股本、儲備                 attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital,
  及保留盈利）。                            reserves and retained earnings.

  本公司董事定期審閱資本架構。作為該審                 The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
  閱的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成本及                 basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the
  與各類資本有關的風險，並採取適當措施                 cost of capital and the risks associated with each class of capital, and take
  平衡整體資本架構。                          appropriate actions to balance its overall capital structure.
